::: column-page
Hi there, I’m Yusuf Ansari.

I am a biostatistician in the Department of Data Science at the University of Mississippi Medical Center (UMMC) and a PhD student (PT) with research interests in longitudinal data analysis, survival analysis, joint models, and statistical computing.

My collaborative research has included work with the Department of Pediatrics at UMMC, the MIND Center at UMMC, and the Jackson Heart Study (JHS), spanning a variety of biomedical and clinical research questions.
:::
